about: Band Survivors rules shared by every level and every engine (the web game reads this; a Unity version reads the same file). Times in a run are VS minutes m = 15 * t / run length. Sources: docs/research/survivors-difficulty-numbers.md 3.3-3.4 (Vampire Survivors game data) and survivors-genre-learnings.md section 10; numbers marked 'ours' were set by tools/sim.mjs.
